culpritSource.quote: After investigating, it is revealed the culprit (Masaharu Motoyama) took two plane rides to create his alibi. Instead of taking the direct route from Miyazaki to Okinawa, Motoyama had taken a plane to Tokyo first, then a retour flight (Flight JAL 931) to Okinawa, where he arrived at 9:20 am, precisely 10 minutes before he committed the murder. He then returned to the airport, pretending that he had just come off the direct Miyazaki-Okinawa flight. Hence Motoyama's cryptic historical reference to him being Hideyoshi and Noze being Mitsuhide, as Hideyoshi had caught up with Mitsuhide much quicke

motive.zhHans: 网球表面的绒布留不住 Motoyama 的指纹，小五郎故意说成相反的情况，为的是让 Motoyama 自己带着他和警方去找那件沾血的雨衣和凶刀——它们还藏在 Motoyama 为行凶而租的那辆车的后备箱里。后来野濑利用自己的人脉替 Motoyama 弄到了体育记者的工作；而 Motoyama 事后通过一段体育脱口秀未经剪辑的录音震惊地得知，野濑当初是故意让他退出竞技生涯的，为的是除掉这个他视为争夺名声的对手。
motive.en: While the tennis ball's felt coating could not retain Motoyama's fingerprints, Kogoro has suggested otherwise in order to have Motoyama guide him and the police to the location of the bloodstained raincoat and murder knife, still hidden in the trunk of the car Motoyama rented for the deed. While Nose subsequently used his contacts to get Motoyama the sports reporting job, a shocked Motoyama learned later, through an unedited studio recording of a sports talkshow, that Nose had intentionally caused Motoyama to drop out of active sports in order to get rid of, what he considered, his competitor for fame.

method.zhHans: 经调查揭示，犯人（Masaharu Motoyama）坐了两趟飞机来制造不在场证明。随后他回到机场，装作自己刚从那班宫崎—冲绳直飞航班下来。Motoyama 碰巧与柯南、小兰和小五郎同机，并且化了装，还接住了小兰不小心掉下的一颗球。后来野濑利用自己的人脉替 Motoyama 弄到了体育记者的工作；而 Motoyama 事后通过一段体育脱口秀未经剪辑的录音震惊地得知，野濑当初是故意让他退出竞技生涯的，为的是除掉这个他视为争夺名声的对手。
method.en: After investigating, it is revealed the culprit (Masaharu Motoyama) took two plane rides to create his alibi. He then returned to the airport, pretending that he had just come off the direct Miyazaki-Okinawa flight. Motoyama was incidentally on the same flight Conan, Ran and Kogoro had boarded and, in disguise, had caught one of the balls Ran had inadvertently dropped. While Nose subsequently used his contacts to get Motoyama the sports reporting job, a shocked Motoyama learned later, through an unedited studio recording of a sports talkshow, that Nose had intentionally caused Motoyama to drop out of active sports in order to get rid of, what he considered, his competitor for fame.

resolution.zhHans: 经调查揭示，犯人（Masaharu Motoyama）坐了两趟飞机来制造不在场证明。他没有走宫崎到冲绳的直飞航线，而是先飞到东京，再搭乘一趟返回航班（JAL 931），于上午 9:20 抵达冲绳——正好在他行凶前 10 分钟。随后他回到机场，装作自己刚从那班宫崎—冲绳直飞航班下来。因此 Motoyama 才留下那句晦涩的历史典故：他是秀吉，野濑是光秀——因为秀吉追上光秀的速度远比预想得快。
resolution.en: After investigating, it is revealed the culprit (Masaharu Motoyama) took two plane rides to create his alibi. Instead of taking the direct route from Miyazaki to Okinawa, Motoyama had taken a plane to Tokyo first, then a retour flight (Flight JAL 931) to Okinawa, where he arrived at 9:20 am, precisely 10 minutes before he committed the murder. He then returned to the airport, pretending that he had just come off the direct Miyazaki-Okinawa flight. Hence Motoyama's cryptic historical reference to him being Hideyoshi and Noze being Mitsuhide, as Hideyoshi had caught up with Mitsuhide much quicker than anticipated.
